Where do I actually play the game?: Where do I actually play the game?
On chess.com or Lichess — whichever plat: On chess.com or Lichess — whichever platform the listing was created for. Stakly doesn't host the chessboard; we handle the escrow and the result verification. Open the platform you've linked, play your opponent, then come back here. We do the rest automatically.
How does Stakly know who won?: How does Stakly know who won?
We read the result directly from the che: We read the result directly from the chess.com or Lichess API as soon as your game finishes. The match settles automatically — no "I won / I lost" buttons. The API is the source of truth, so neither player can claim a result the game didn't produce.
How long does it take to settle after th: How long does it take to settle after the game ends?
Usually within a few seconds. We poll co: Usually within a few seconds. We poll continuously while you're on this page and every five minutes in the background as a safety net, so even if you close the tab the match will settle on its own. chess.com archives can lag 5–15 seconds; Lichess is real-time.
What if something goes wrong during the: What if something goes wrong during the match?
Two escape hatches: Request cancellation: Two escape hatches: Request cancellation (your opponent has to agree — both stakes refunded, no fee, doesn't count toward your record) or Report a problem (sends the match to admin review). Use cancellation for cooperative exits, Report a problem for cheating, ghosting, or anything else where you need a human to look.
How is the platform fee calculated?: How is the platform fee calculated?
A flat 10% of the pot, taken from the wi: A flat 10% of the pot, taken from the winner's payout. For example, on a $100 stake (pot = $200), the winner takes $180 and Stakly takes $20. Draws have no fee — both players get their original stake back in full.
When do I receive my payout?: When do I receive my payout?
Immediately when the match settles. Your: Immediately when the match settles. Your USDT balance updates the moment the result is recorded — refresh your wallet to see it.
